params.command: $p=Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA 'MhwModManager'; if(Test-Path $p){Write-Output ('ROOT='+$p); Get-ChildItem $p -Force | Select-Object Name,FullName,Attributes,LastWriteTimeUtc | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3}else{Write-Output ('ABSENT='+$p)}; Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.ProcessName -like '*MHW*Mod*Manager*' -or $_.ProcessName -like '*MhwModManager*'} | Select-Object Id,ProcessName,Path | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3
